My prescription has been rejected multiple times without any clear explanation. When I contacted reception on two separate occasions, no one was able to tell me why this had happened. I was then booked for an appointment with the pharmacist, who told me that the medication is only given for a specific condition and claimed that I do not have it. This is very concerning, as I have been diagnosed with this condition since 2020.

After this, I contacted reception again and asked to speak with a doctor. Instead of arranging this, I received a message stating that I no longer need the medication. This decision was made without any direct consultation or discussion with me.

When I insisted on speaking with a doctor, I was told I would have to wait two days, despite explaining that I only have enough medication until Friday. This lack of urgency and communication is unacceptable.
